first-toungoo-empire.json L26/L59: Kengtung is a Toungoo vassal 1562-1597; ming-dynasty.json L53 (1563) already loses the Chinese Shan states to Toungoo, and L56 (1600) re-adds 'Myanmar' cells marked unverified. No Ming tie to Kengtung is documented after 1563.
